description: Signed lock v6 / execution v5 proof bundles under the grid-frequency tag drand-quicknet+elexon-freq-v1, each with exactly one signed field tampered (on one receipt, or on both for receipt both) and re-signed with the vector key, so only the semantic checks can refuse it. When the lock receipt is tampered, the execution receipt's lock_receipt_hash is recomputed and re-signed too. Each case must fail exactly expected_failing_steps and never pass. The bases pass.
